cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Hope Keeps Moving
cards.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Our bookshop failed here. We're meant to find readers somewhere else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then we're meant to start smaller. One shelf, properly chosen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I could get us a market stall beside the bus stop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: People waiting with nothing to read! I'll pack the short stories. We've been making our customers come too far.

mechanism: A corrects planning like the only expert and turns each setback into evidence of a better delayed or redirected outcome.
confusable: Simple persistence differs from interpreting each disappointment as revealing where the desired outcome belongs.
comparison: Wedding logistics shift time then location; a failed bookshop shifts scale then finds waiting readers.
seedUse: Retain the causal venue and market-stall pivots while making the expert planning method shape the hope.
